note: Stage 0 fixtures. Original placeholder copy so the CTA can be built end to end before ingest exists. Stage 1 replaces these with real messages and their per-post source_url.

topics.label: Birthday wishes for friends
messages: Happy birthday to the friend who makes ordinary days worth remembering. Here's to another year of us.
Another trip around the sun, and I'm still lucky to have you along for it. Happy birthday!
Wishing you a day as warm and generous as you have always been to me. Happy birthday, my friend.
Happy birthday! Thanks for the laughs, the long talks, and for putting up with me. Have the best one.
To my favourite partner in mischief, may this year bring you everything you have been quietly hoping for.
Happy birthday, friend. However you celebrate today, I hope it feels exactly right.
Some friends you keep, and some friends keep you. Thanks for being the second kind. Happy birthday!
Cheers to you today! May your year ahead be full of good news and even better company.

topics.label: Birthday wishes
messages: Wishing you a very happy birthday and a year filled with good health, good people and good news.
Happy birthday! May today be gentle, joyful, and entirely about you.
Sending you the warmest birthday wishes and a hope that this year treats you kindly.
Happy birthday! Here's to celebrating you today and everything you will do in the year ahead.
May your birthday be the start of a year that surprises you in all the best ways.
Have a wonderful birthday. You deserve a day that feels as good as you make others feel.
Happy birthday! Take the day, enjoy every bit of it, and let someone else do the dishes.
Many happy returns of the day. Wishing you joy now and all year through.

topics.label: Anniversary wishes
messages: Happy anniversary! Here's to the years behind you and all the ones still to come.
Congratulations on another year together. May your love keep growing quieter, deeper and stronger.
Happy anniversary to two people who make it look easy. Wishing you many more.
Celebrating you both today: your patience, your laughter, and the life you have built together.
Happy anniversary! May this year bring you as much happiness as you have given each other.
To a wonderful couple on a wonderful day: happy anniversary, with love.
Another year, another reason to celebrate the two of you. Happy anniversary!
Wishing you a lovely anniversary and a year full of the small moments that matter most.

topics.label: Thank you messages
messages: Thank you so much. Your kindness made more of a difference than you know.
I am truly grateful for your help. Thank you for showing up when it mattered.
Thank you for your thoughtfulness. It brightened my whole week.
Just a note to say thank you. I really appreciate everything you did.
Words don't quite cover it, but thank you, sincerely.
Thank you for your generosity and your time. Both mean a great deal to me.
I can't thank you enough. You made something hard feel a lot easier.
With heartfelt thanks for your kindness and your support.

topics.label: Get well soon messages
messages: Wishing you a smooth and speedy recovery. Take all the time you need.
Thinking of you and hoping each day feels a little better than the last.
Get well soon! Rest up, everything else can wait.
Sending warm wishes your way for a quick return to full strength.
Hope you are back on your feet soon. Until then, be kind to yourself.
Feel better soon. You are missed, and you are in my thoughts.
Wishing you comfort, rest and a healthy recovery.
Here's to brighter, healthier days ahead. Get well soon!

topics.label: Congratulations messages
messages: Congratulations! You worked for this, and it shows.
So happy for you. This is wonderful news. Congratulations!
Congratulations on your success. Enjoy this one, you have earned it.
Well done! Wishing you even more good news in the days ahead.
Congratulations! Watching you get here has been a pleasure.
Huge congratulations. Here's to whatever comes next.
What an achievement. Congratulations, and enjoy every minute.
Cheers to you and this brilliant news. Congratulations!

topics.label: Love and romance messages
messages: You make ordinary days feel like something worth keeping. I love you.
Still you. Always you. I love you more than I can fit in a card.
Thank you for being my favourite person. I love you.
Every day with you is my favourite day. All my love.
I love you for the big things, and for all the small ones too.
You have my whole heart, today and always.
Loving you is the easiest thing I do. Always yours.
Here's to us. I love you, now and for a long time yet.

topics.label: Messages for any card
messages: Thinking of you today and sending my very best wishes.
Just a little note to let you know you are on my mind.
Wishing you all the best, today and always.
Sending warm wishes your way. Hope this finds you well.
Here's to a wonderful day and an even better year ahead.
With very best wishes and a great deal of warmth.
Hope your day is a good one. You deserve it.
Sending you happiness, health and a little extra luck.
